## R-AIRSPEED

**Airspeed sensor placement and accuracy** — The pitot sits outside the prop slipstream in cruise (>= 1 prop radius laterally clear of every disc edge, or ahead of the prop plane; B4's wash-error bound CL-B4-PITOT <= 2 % is the working form), and the airspeed error at cruise (16 m/s), taken as the root-sum-square of the error budget (sensor, prop wash, calibration residual, resolution) after ARSPD_AUTOCAL and reciprocal legs, is <= 0.5 m/s (D-37: the margin from cruise down to 1.3 Vs is 0.49-0.58 m/s); in flight, the mean of |ARSPD - GPS-derived true airspeed| over a four-leg reciprocal box in calm air is within that limit — **UNVERIFIED**  
Defined in: redesign/config-study/tiebreak/DECISION.md#5.1

## R-DISCONNECT

**Connectors carry the current** — Every power connector and the main disconnect (AS150U, D-32) are rated >= 1.25 x the continuous design current, defined as the largest of the hover, cruise and vertical-climb currents on E2's pessimistic profile at 30 degC (CL-F1-I-CONT), and carry the <= 60 s case and the <= 5 s momentary case (120 A unlimited; 100 A with the limiter, 105 A with a 5 % sensor under-read) inside a cited rating; aircraft-side wiring: steady temperature rise <= 10 degC at the continuous design current (electrical.wire_temp_rise_max_c) and <= 30 degC for any case shorter than 60 s (electrical.wire_temp_rise_short_max_c; conductor <= 60 degC, 14 K under the XPS limit); the pack's own leads (>= 10 AWG after re-termination): steady rise <= 20 degC (electrical.pack_lead_rise_max_c; conductor <= 50 degC, cell tabs under the 60 degC LiPo limit) — **UNVERIFIED**  
Defined in: redesign/config-study/REQUIREMENTS-PROPOSED.md#P18

## R-FAILSAFES

## R-GUST-LEAN

**8 m/s gust survive-and-land** — The hover attitude needed to hold position in an 8 m/s gust (flat-plate method, wing broadside) is <= Q_A_ANGLE_MAX minus 5 deg (F4 sets Q_A_ANGLE_MAX accordingly), and the thrust needed at that lean (W / cos lean) leaves a thrust headroom >= 1.3 at the gate mass with voltage sag — **UNVERIFIED**  
Defined in: redesign/config-study/REQUIREMENTS-PROPOSED.md#P8


## R-HARNESS-INSTALL

**Wiring is an installation** — Every wire in the wire list has a route, supports <= 0.15 m apart, chafe protection at every edge, strain relief at every connector and a service loop across each elevon hinge; the ESC-to-motor leads run along the fin; no connector carries structural load; the pack plug is the only field disconnect — **UNVERIFIED**  
Defined in: redesign/inputs/ADVISOR-XV24-LESSONS.md#3

## R-HOVER-AUTHORITY

**Hover control authority** — At the gate mass in hover, motor-differential control gives an angular acceleration on each body axis >= 2 rad/s2 and >= 1.5 x the acceleration the 5 m/s wind moment demands, using <= 30 % of hover thrust per motor as differential after the pitch-trim split (R-HOVER-SPLIT); the 30 % cap applies on every axis, yaw included (CR-B3-16: D-27 raised the cant to 7 deg rather than lift the cap); yaw (about the hover vertical, from the 7 deg tangential cant plus prop reaction torque) is the axis to show — **UNVERIFIED**  
Defined in: redesign/config-study/REQUIREMENTS-PROPOSED.md#P8

## R-LANDING-IMPACT

**Fin-tip landing** — The four replaceable constant-force feet absorb a hard landing at 1.2 m/s sink (the pilot's down-stick limit Q_PILOT_SPD_DN, which F4 holds <= this value; the controller's own final descent is Q_LAND_FINAL_SPD 0.3 m/s) with 2/3 W of lift still on, at any touchdown tilt <= 10 deg of combined tilt in any direction (pitch, roll or diagonal: one foot takes the energy first, D-65), with airframe load factor <= 6.6 at the as-designed mass and >= 3 mm of the usable stroke left on the worst foot (foot stroke >= 0.038 m, C5's 3 mm guard), no damage beyond the feet; the foot side load from the pads scrubbing at mu 0.7 while the aircraft rotates onto the other feet (CL-C5-SIM3D-SIDE-LOAD limit, -SIDE-ULT ultimate) is the design side load for the shoe sleeve, the fin tip and the fin root (D5, C4 / D3, C1); shown by C5's 6-DOF touchdown model with four crushing feet (CR-C5-17) validated by T-C5-AIRCRAFT-DROP, while C1's 1.5 m/s level and one-foot cases L1 / L4 stay the structural bounds (R-LOADS); a foot is replaced in <= 10 min in the field (snap-fit piston, no adhesive); horizontal groundspeed at contact <= — m/s (C5 derives it from the 30 deg tip-over margin and the foot friction; NASA CR-132423 p. 60 tolerates 2 kt = 1.03 m/s in hover just before touchdown; review/NASA-CR-132423-COMPLIANCE.md C-14, G-05), logged at every touchdown by H2 (M2) — **UNVERIFIED** **FAILS**  
Defined in: redesign/params/CHANGE-LOG.md#D-65

## R-PACK-RETENTION

**Pack retained in a crash** — The pack stays in the pod and the hatch stays closed under a 12 g deceleration in any axis (5 m/s arrested in 0.10 m of foam crush); the strap, tray, stops and pod-to-wing bond carry that load with margin >= 0, and the XPS crush block ahead of the pack (D-25) holds any 503-680 g pack to <= 100 g in a 5 m/s nose-in crash — **UNVERIFIED** **FAILS**

## R-PILOT

**Pilot readiness** — The designated pilot logs >= 10 h of ArduPilot SITL on the tailsitter model with the team's parameter file, including QSTABILIZE recovery from a failed transition, plus stick time on the foam-board twin or a small quad, before the first XPS hover — **UNVERIFIED**  
Defined in: redesign/config-study/requirements/REQUIREMENTS.md#D15


## R-PROCESS

**Build processes** — Every part in every parts.csv is bought or made by one of: hot-wire XPS from printed templates, packing-tape skin, knife- or laser-cut foam board, FDM PETG or PLA, epoxy or CA bonds, standard fasteners, hand-cut CF tube; no composite lay-up, no machining beyond drilling; printed parts <= 0.2 m on any axis — **UNVERIFIED**  
Defined in: redesign/config-study/REQUIREMENTS-PROPOSED.md#P10


## R-PROOF-BUILD

**Proof chain builds** — proofs/build_graph.py exits 0 with zero drift; every requirement in this set has >= 1 claim with a how-to-verify line before CDR; build_graph.py --strict passes (no negative margin, no unverified requirement) before the first flight — **UNVERIFIED**  
Defined in: redesign/proofs/README.md

## R-SITE

**Site rules and flight card** — Flights only at RFS yellow sub-fields 1-4, within 06:00-sunset (flight card 07:00-10:00), <= 400 ft AGL, VLOS <= 500 m from the pilot, with a spotter, a request >= 7 business days ahead and a post-flight report within 3 business days; each session starts with the field-map sheet (landing zone, approach sector, alternate spot, clearance of one zone width to the pilot box and other pads, obstacle survey of every object > 3 m (EST) inside the fence, pre-flight walk of zone, sector and alternate; NASA CR-132423 p. 42, 58-59, 166-167; review/NASA-CR-132423-COMPLIANCE.md C-15, G-03); no Remote ID module while every flight is inside the FRIA (a conditional line stays in the BOM) — **UNVERIFIED**  
Defined in: redesign/config-study/requirements/REQUIREMENTS.md#D5


## R-SPIRAL

**Spiral mode** — In cruise at the gate mass the spiral mode's time to double t2 >= 3.3 s at every CG inside cg.x_range_m and cg.z_range_m (0.0165 to 0.025 m; B3 sens_zcg.py gives 3.34 s at the top of the z range, 3.51 s at the 0.0185 m target, CL-B3-V-LAT-T2); the 4 s MIL-F-8785C Level 3 floor for a hand-flown aircraft is not required because wing-borne flight is flown only in roll-stabilised modes: every FLTMODE1-6 in K09L.param is a mode whose roll loop holds the bank (QSTABILIZE, QHOVER, QLOITER, QLAND, QRTL, FBWA, CRUISE, RTL, AUTO), never MANUAL, ACRO or STABILIZE (D-50), and no raw-stick fixed-wing mode is flown above 5 m AGL (flight card); the Dutch-roll and short-period dampings stay above B3's floors (R-DIRECTIONAL). A1's position D-66 option (b): the CG height stays, the limit is 3.3 s — **UNVERIFIED**  
Defined in: redesign/params/CHANGE-LOG.md#D-66

## R-TEST-ORDER

**Test gates in order** — Gates passed and logged in order, none skipped: (1) twin (R-TWIN); (2) thrust stand, one station (R-HOVER-TW); (3) XPS aircraft weigh-in (R-MASS-GATE) and tethered hover with current within +/-0.15 x 27 A of that value and the limiter verified (R-ESC-CURRENT); (4) untethered QHOVER/QLOITER; (5) fixed-wing tune as a plain flying wing; (6) first transition at >= 50 m AGL with QSTABILIZE recovery rehearsed; (7) back-transition at altitude; (8) landing practice in calm air; (9) full mission (R-MISSION). H3 gives go/no-go on the 5 m/s flight card — **UNVERIFIED**  
Defined in: redesign/config-study/tiebreak/DECISION.md#5.4

## R-TIPOVER

**Stance tip-over** — Static tip-over angle toward the pod side (about the narrow axis of the four-foot stance, pad contact at z +/-0.218 m with the feet splayed, z_cg subtracted) >= 30 deg at the worst flying CG (forward end of cg.x_range_m, top of cg.z_range_m, any pack from 503 to 680 g); landings are flown with a wingtip into the wind (flight card, C5 stance rules S1-S8), so the angle needed on that axis is the span-into-wind case, not the broadside one — **UNVERIFIED**  
Defined in: redesign/params/params.json#requirements.tipover_min_deg

## R-TWIN

**Foam-board twin gate** — The foam-board twin on the real motors, FC and pack holds position with 95 % of logged position samples within 1 m of the hold point over a 2 min run (NASA CR-132423 p. 49: accuracy stated at 95 percent likelihood; review/NASA-CR-132423-COMPLIANCE.md C-15, G-08) in calm air and in a 5 m/s fan or breeze with logged lean <= 20 deg; flies QLOITER at >= 30 m; completes a transition at >= 1.3 Vs, two laps and a back-transition; hover current within +/-0.15 x 27 A of that value and cruise near 16.2 A; the elevon size that gives clean FBWA authority is recorded. A wind fail triggers the K11 planform test, then the K01 fallback (CONFIGURATION.md) — **UNVERIFIED**  
Defined in: redesign/config-study/tiebreak/DECISION.md#8


## R-VIBRATION

**Rotor-excited vibration** — (a) Fin stations: the first bending and torsion natural frequencies of each motor tube + through-core block + half-fins + mount assembly with motors fitted lie outside +/-0.2 of 1P at hover rpm and of 2P (blade pass) at hover and cruise rpm; the operating points are the criterion of record and B4's 80-330 Hz whole-band rule is advisory (CR-C4-06); C4's CL-C4-D3-SEP on the two-layer fin (D-26) supersedes CL-J1-TUBE-MODE-SEP, and the 3-D solid FE of the as-designed station (CL-C4-SIM-SEP 0.29: lower station 255.5 Hz against 2P cruise 198.2 Hz at 5 946 rpm with the 84.2 g motor) is the value of record; re-run triggers (D-70, CR-C4-39): C4 re-runs the station model when the cruise rpm (CL-B4-CRUISE-RPM) exceeds 6 390 rpm or a station's mass grows more than 15 % above the as-designed 84.2 g motor + 7.6 g ESC + 4 g bullets. (b) Wing modes: the station-participating wing modes (antisymmetric torsion 12-15 Hz, in-plane ~215 Hz) cannot clear the same windows with any spar from 16 to 25 mm (CL-C2-WING-MODE-SEP, D-45), so they are closed by the tap-test branch: the tap test of the finished wing with motors fitted (T-C2-TAP-TEST) shows each such mode either damped or inside the rpm-tracking harmonic notch (F4 INS_HNTCH_* on ESC rpm, CL-F4-NOTCH-LOW, covering 1P and 2P over the rpm range), the rate-loop crossover stays <= 5 Hz, and B3 carries the 12-15 Hz antisymmetric torsion mode in the hover loop model. (c) The flight-controller vibration (ArduPilot VIBE) stays < 30 m/s2 in hover with Clip = 0 — **UNVERIFIED** **FAILS**  
Defined in: redesign/params/CHANGE-LOG.md#D-45

## R-WIND-MEASURE

**RFS wind measured** — RFS morning wind is measured with a handheld anemometer on >= 3 mornings at 2 m height against the RCMC1 real-time reading; the ratio RFS/RCMC1 is < 1.4 (else the K01 reversal in CONFIGURATION.md applies) and the flight-card limit is rescaled to the measured ratio — **UNVERIFIED**  
Defined in: redesign/CONFIGURATION.md#reverse-to-k01
